name: Castle Thorn
summary: Castle Thorn is a group dungeon nestled in the Haafingar Mountains of Western Skyrim. It is part of the Stonethorn dungeon pack DLC, along with Stone Garden. The vampire lord Lady Thorn, once a High Elf of Clan Direnni named Lady Ingerien, rules from here, commanding her Thorn Legion. Crows, fleshflies, rats and spiders can be found in numbers within the dungeon.
notes: The entrance to Castle Thorn has been present since Update 26, with one of the towers also being present in the distance.
